scenes.name: THE QUESTION
lines: Four vertices, six arrows along a path, and one endpoint loop: seven arcs in all.
四个点，路径上六条箭头，再加一个端点自环，总共七条弧。
Put any nonzero real weight on every arc. How few arcs can guarantee matrix rigidity for every weighting?
每条弧都填任意非零实数。至少多少条弧，才能保证每种填法都有矩阵刚性？
The answer is twice the number of vertices, minus one.
答案是顶点数的两倍减一。

scenes.name: ONE OR EVERY
lines: The rigidity test asks whether a commuting matrix, with zeros forced at reversed arc positions, must be zero.
刚性检验问：与原矩阵可交换，又在弧的反向位置被迫为零的矩阵，是否只能为零？
Two isolated loops with weights one and two pass this test. Give both loops weight one, and a nonzero obstruction survives.
两个孤立自环分别填一与二能通过检验；若都填一，就会留下非零障碍。
So allowing means one successful weighting; requiring means every weighting succeeds.
所以，允许指有一种成功填法；要求指每种填法都成功。

scenes.name: MATRICES INTO FLOWS
lines: Now record a product on each arc: its weight times the reversed entry of a commuting matrix.
现在给每条弧记录一个乘积：弧权重乘以可交换矩阵的反向条目。
Commutation says that the incoming total equals the outgoing total at every vertex. Negative flow values are allowed.
可交换意味着每个点的流入总量等于流出总量，流的数值允许为负。
For a matrix with the rigidity property, this recording loses no information: zero records force the whole commuting matrix to vanish.
如果原矩阵具有这种刚性，记录就不丢信息：全部记录为零会迫使整个可交换矩阵为零。

scenes.name: COUNTING FREEDOM
lines: On this three-vertex path, opposite flows must match. The loop and the two arrow pairs leave three free numbers.
在这条三点路径上，相反方向的流必须相等；自环和两对箭头留下三个自由数。
In general, a connected graph with m arcs and n vertices has m minus n plus one independent balanced flows.
一般地，连通图有 m 条弧、n 个点时，独立平衡流的个数是 m 减 n 加一。
Commuting matrices always have at least n independent choices. An injective recording must fit them all, forcing m to be at least twice n minus one.
可交换矩阵总有至少 n 个独立选择；单射记录必须装下全部选择，因此 m 至少为二 n 减一。

scenes.name: WHY CONNECTED
lines: Why must a requiring support be connected? Every component needs a loop, or its diagonal indicator is an obstruction.
要求支撑为什么必须连通？每个分量都得有自环，否则其对角指示矩阵就是障碍。
With two groups of components, tune their loops so both share eigenvalue one. Their eigenvectors then create a nonzero obstruction between the groups.
若有两组分量，调节自环使两组都有特征值一；它们的特征向量就能在组间产生非零障碍。
One bad weighting defeats requiring. Thus the connected lower bound applies.
一种坏填法就足以否定要求，所以连通下界适用于原问题。

scenes.name: ATTAINING THE BOUND
lines: The endpoint-looped double path, a construction of Koljančić and Oblak, reaches the bound with arbitrary nonzero real weights.
Koljančić 与 Oblak 的端点带环双向路径构造，对任意非零实权重都达到下界。
The forced zeros spread to every odd offset of the commuting matrix. The endpoint loop then kills its first column.
强制零传播到可交换矩阵的所有奇数偏移带，端点自环再消去第一列。
Repeatedly applying the original matrix to the first coordinate vector gives a basis. The commuting matrix kills that basis, so it is zero.
反复把原矩阵作用在第一个坐标向量上，得到一组基；可交换矩阵消灭这组基，所以它为零。

scenes.name: THE MINIMUM
lines: The requiring minimum is therefore two n minus one for every positive order, including one vertex with one loop.
所以每个正阶的要求最小值都是二 n 减一，也包括一个点配一个自环的情形。
This counts the minimum; it does not classify every optimal support. The written explanation gives the full proof and its exact formal evidence.
这确定了最小值，却没有分类全部最优支撑；书面讲解给出完整证明及其准确形式证据。
